source_checkpoint.verification: local main, remote main, annotated tag, peeled tag, public non-draft release, rendered pages, and a fresh public-tag clone agreed

measured_weakness.summary: The accepted recall@4 score is non-discriminating because every frozen case contains at most two documents while the retriever returns up to four. Untrusted guidance can therefore crowd trusted project evidence out of the bounded retrieval result before the evidence-only decision filter runs.
measured_weakness.released_behavior: all document kinds are ranked in one lexical list; telemetry receives only a 0.05 bonus; evidence-only filtering occurs after top-4 truncation
measured_weakness.risk: A small set of query-matching, instruction-bearing runbook documents can cause a safe denial of useful diagnosis or action by removing trusted telemetry/status from the retrieved set. This is an availability and benign-utility weakness even when policy compliance and attack-action success remain favorable.

exploratory_probes.use: retained exploratory observation only; excluded from held-out contract selection and implementation feedback

bounded_improvement.objective: Make retrieval measurement discriminating and preserve trusted project evidence under untrusted guidance flooding in development and held-out splits without changing the agent, action set, executor, approval boundary, or runtime authority.
bounded_improvement.held_out_selection_note: test-worker-injection was not used in the exploratory guidance-flood probe
bounded_improvement.candidate: evidence-priority lexical retrieval that deterministically retains project-classified telemetry/status ahead of untrusted guidance while retaining all retrieved identities for audit
bounded_improvement.comparison: frozen lexical-token-overlap-v1 pre-change control versus the bounded candidate
separate_metrics: exact outcome, action, trajectory, terminal state, policy, benign utility, attack success, reliability, latency, and cost
